customer_id.meaning: primary id of the member record; the same profile serves a member acting as a guest, as a host, or as both

name.meaning: member's full name exactly as printed on the driving licence held on file

phone_number.meaning: mobile number registered on the member profile; the number trip and payout notifications are sent to

email.meaning: email address registered on the member profile, stored exactly as the member entered it

date_of_birth.meaning: member's date of birth as read from the driving licence; the basis of every driver-age condition

driver_licence_number.meaning: driving licence number on file, stored exactly as printed on the licence

licence_issuing_state.meaning: two-letter code of the state or province that issued the licence on file

licence_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date printed on the licence on file; a licence is valid up to and including this date

postal_code.meaning: postal code of the member's billing address

account_opened_date.meaning: date the member profile was first opened on the marketplace

member_role.meaning: which sides of the marketplace this member is registered to act on

home_city.meaning: city the member gives as their home market, stored as entered

driver_score.meaning: marketplace driving-behaviour score, 100 being the best; recomputed by the risk platform and never edited by support

preferred_language.meaning: language the member is contacted in

booking_id.meaning: primary id of the trip booking record; the reference number quoted on every trip charge

customer_id.meaning: the guest who booked the trip (foreign key -> customers)

host_customer_id.meaning: the host whose vehicle is booked (foreign key -> customers)

vehicle_id.meaning: the listed vehicle the trip is booked on (foreign key -> listings_vehicles)

election_id.meaning: the guest protection election attached to this booking (foreign key -> guestplan_elections); empty until a protection level is elected

rate_plan_name.meaning: the rate plan the booking is priced under, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the booking (basis defined in the trips lifecycle)

requested_date.meaning: date the guest submitted the booking request

confirmed_date.meaning: date the booking was confirmed against the host's calendar; empty while still requested

trip_start_date.meaning: scheduled first day of the trip as reserved

trip_end_date.meaning: scheduled last day of the trip as reserved, including any approved extension

actual_start_date.meaning: date the guest actually checked the vehicle out; empty until the trip starts

actual_end_date.meaning: date the guest actually returned the vehicle; empty until the trip ends

settled_date.meaning: date every end-of-trip charge was posted and the booking was closed for billing; empty until settled

cancelled_date.meaning: date the booking was cancelled; empty unless cancelled

cancellation_initiator.meaning: who ended the booking before it started; none while the booking is live

pickup_channel.meaning: how the guest takes possession of the vehicle at the start of the trip

delivery_location_type.meaning: kind of place the vehicle is delivered to; none when the guest collects it themselves

daily_rate_amount.meaning: the host's daily price locked in for this booking at the moment it was confirmed

reserved_hours_total.meaning: hours currently reserved on this booking; identically the sum of the booked_hours account deltas

included_miles_total.meaning: total included miles granted to this booking to date

miles_remaining.format: whole miles, may be negative once the allowance is exceeded
miles_remaining.meaning: included miles still unused; identically the sum of the mileage_allowance account deltas

balance_due.meaning: amount the guest still owes on this booking; identically the sum of the guest_balance account deltas

payment_method_last4.format: last 4 digits of the card on file
payment_method_last4.meaning: card the trip charges are taken from, identified by its last four digits

promo_code_applied.meaning: promotional code the guest quoted at booking, stored exactly as given; empty when none was used

charge_id.meaning: primary id of the trip charge line

booking_id.meaning: the booking this charge line belongs to (foreign key -> trips_bookings)

customer_id.meaning: the guest the charge line is raised against (foreign key -> customers)

source_charge_id.meaning: the earlier charge line this one reverses, credits or corrects; empty on an original charge

event_type.meaning: event-family type of this charge line, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the trips charter

charge_date.meaning: date the charge line was posted to the booking

charge_amount.meaning: money moved by this line; charges are positive and refunds or credits are negative

charge_basis.meaning: the priced item this line stands for; the dimension that keeps two lines posted on the same day apart

quantity_units.format: countable units to 1 decimal place (miles, hours or tank percentage points, according to the basis)
quantity_units.meaning: how many units the line was priced on; 0.0 on a flat charge

unit_rate_amount.meaning: the per-unit price applied to quantity_units; 0.00 on a flat charge

billing_period.meaning: the point in the trip at which this line falls due

payment_channel.meaning: how the money for this line is taken or returned

waiver_code.meaning: the ground on which the line was waived or credited; none on an ordinary charge

usage_id.meaning: primary id of the trip usage record

booking_id.meaning: the booking the reading or allowance belongs to (foreign key -> trips_bookings)

customer_id.meaning: the guest whose trip the record belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type of this usage record, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the trips charter

usage_date.meaning: date the reading was taken or the allowance was granted

reading_point.meaning: the moment in the trip this record was captured at

odometer_reading.meaning: odometer shown on the vehicle at this reading; 0 on an allowance grant that carries no reading

miles_delta.meaning: change booked to the booking's mileage allowance; positive when miles are granted and negative when driven miles consume them

fuel_percent.meaning: percentage points of fuel tank or traction battery shown at this reading; 0 on records that carry no fuel reading

fuel_type.meaning: what the vehicle is fuelled by, which decides whether refuelling or recharging rules apply

usage_source.meaning: where the reading came from, which decides how authoritative it is

grant_reason.meaning: why miles were granted; none on a consumption or fuel record

extension_request_id.meaning: primary id of the trip extension request

booking_id.meaning: the booking the guest is asking to extend (foreign key -> trips_bookings)

customer_id.meaning: the guest making the request (foreign key -> customers)

requested_end_date.meaning: the new last day of the trip the guest is asking for

additional_hours.meaning: how much longer the guest wants the vehicle for, measured from the current scheduled return

quoted_amount.meaning: price quoted to the guest for the extra time at the moment the request was taken

request_status.meaning: how far the extension request has got

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the host protection enrolment; one enrolment covers one vehicle

customer_id.meaning: the host who holds the protection enrolment (foreign key -> customers)

vehicle_id.meaning: the listed vehicle the enrolment protects (foreign key -> listings_vehicles)

protection_plan_name.meaning: the host protection plan in force, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the enrolment (basis defined in the hostplan lifecycle)

enrolled_date.meaning: date the host applied for this protection plan

effective_date.meaning: first date on which the plan protects trips; empty until the enrolment goes active

ended_date.meaning: date protection ceased; empty while the enrolment is still live

plan_change_effective_date.meaning: date the most recent plan change takes effect from; empty when the host has never changed plan

claim_free_since_date.meaning: date from which this enrolment has been free of settled claims; reset whenever a claim is settled against it

reimbursement_balance_due.meaning: amount still owed to the host on settled claims; identically the sum of the claim_reimbursement account deltas

liability_balance_due.meaning: amount the host still owes as their share of losses; identically the sum of the host_liability account deltas

protection_region.meaning: the territory the enrolment is written for, which decides which regional protection terms apply

vehicle_value_declared_amount.meaning: the vehicle value the host declared at enrolment, against which the plan's ceiling is tested

suspension_reason.meaning: why protection is suspended; none while the enrolment is in good standing

claim_id.meaning: primary id of the damage claim record

enrollment_id.meaning: the protection enrolment the claim is made under (foreign key -> hostplan_enrollments)

customer_id.meaning: the host making the claim (foreign key -> customers)

booking_id.meaning: the trip during which the loss occurred (foreign key -> trips_bookings); the key that ties the loss to one guest

source_claim_id.meaning: the original claim this record supplements, settles or reverses; empty on a first filing

event_type.meaning: event-family type of this claim record, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the hostplan charter

claim_date.meaning: date this claim record was written

loss_date.meaning: date the damage or loss occurred, as established from the trip record

damage_category.meaning: the kind of loss claimed, which decides which appraisal route and which sub-limit apply

claim_amount.meaning: amount claimed on this record before appraisal

appraisal_amount.meaning: amount the appraisal established as the cost of repair or replacement; 0.00 until appraised

amount_delta.meaning: money booked to the enrolment's accounts by this record; positive when it adds to a balance and negative when it clears one

liability_finding.meaning: who the marketplace found responsible for the loss

settlement_reference.meaning: reference number of the repair estimate, invoice or police report the host quotes, stored exactly as given; empty when none was supplied

evidence_count.meaning: how many photographs and documents are on file for this record

decision_channel.meaning: who took the decision recorded on this claim record

claim_intake_id.meaning: primary id of the damage report a host lodges before a claim is opened

customer_id.meaning: the host lodging the report (foreign key -> customers)

enrollment_id.meaning: the protection enrolment the report will be filed under (foreign key -> hostplan_enrollments)

booking_id.meaning: the trip the host says the damage happened on (foreign key -> trips_bookings)

damage_category.meaning: the kind of loss the host reports

intake_status.meaning: how far the damage report has got before a claim record is opened

reported_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
reported_at.meaning: moment the host lodged the report

evidence_count.meaning: how many photographs and documents the host attached to the report

election_id.meaning: primary id of the guest protection election; one election covers one trip

customer_id.meaning: the guest who made the election (foreign key -> customers)

booking_id.meaning: the trip booking the election is attached to (foreign key -> trips_bookings)

protection_level_name.meaning: the protection level the guest elected, written as the official full level name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the election (basis defined in the guestplan lifecycle)

elected_date.meaning: date the guest chose this protection level

effective_date.meaning: first date the protection actually covers; empty until the election goes active

ended_date.meaning: date cover ceased; empty while cover is still running

coverage_days.meaning: number of trip days this election has been charged for to date

protection_fee_balance_due.meaning: protection fee still owed on this election; identically the sum of the protection_fee_due account deltas

deductible_balance_due.meaning: deductible the guest still owes on a loss during this trip; identically the sum of the guest_deductible account deltas

external_insurer_name.meaning: name of the guest's own motor insurer, stored exactly as the guest states it; empty unless the guest declined marketplace protection

declared_secondary_driver_count.meaning: how many approved additional drivers the guest declared on this trip

void_reason.meaning: why the election was voided; none while it stands

protection_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the guest protection charge line

election_id.meaning: the protection election this line belongs to (foreign key -> guestplan_elections)

customer_id.meaning: the guest the line is raised against (foreign key -> customers)

booking_id.meaning: the trip the protection covers (foreign key -> trips_bookings)

covered_claim_id.meaning: the damage claim this line settles against (foreign key -> hostplan_claims); empty on an ordinary fee line

source_charge_id.meaning: the earlier protection line this one credits or corrects; empty on an original line

event_type.meaning: event-family type of this line, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the guestplan charter

charge_date.meaning: date the line was posted to the election

charge_amount.meaning: money moved by this line; charges are positive and credits are negative

charge_basis.meaning: the priced item this line stands for; the dimension that keeps two lines posted on the same day apart

days_covered.meaning: how many trip days the line was priced on; 0 on a flat line

coverage_segment.meaning: which stretch of the trip the line covers, so that a mid-trip change leaves two separable lines

adjustment_reason.meaning: why the line was raised outside the ordinary daily fee; none on an ordinary fee line

change_request_id.meaning: primary id of a request to change protection level on a live trip

customer_id.meaning: the guest making the request (foreign key -> customers)

election_id.meaning: the election the guest wants to change (foreign key -> guestplan_elections)

booking_id.meaning: the trip the election is attached to (foreign key -> trips_bookings)

requested_level_name.meaning: the protection level the guest is asking to move to

request_status.meaning: how far the change request has got

requested_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
requested_at.meaning: moment the guest asked for the change

quoted_difference_amount.meaning: price difference quoted to the guest for the remaining trip days; negative when the change is a credit

payout_account_id.meaning: primary id of the host payout account; one account settles all of a host's earnings

customer_id.meaning: the host the account belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

payout_schedule_name.meaning: the payout schedule the account settles under, written as the official full schedule name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the payout account (basis defined in the payouts lifecycle)

opened_date.meaning: date the payout account was opened

closed_date.meaning: date the payout account was closed; empty while it is still open

bank_account_last4.format: last 4 digits of the deposit account
bank_account_last4.meaning: the deposit account earnings are sent to, identified by its last four digits

payout_method_default.meaning: how money leaves the account unless a single payout says otherwise

available_balance.meaning: earnings free to be paid out; identically the sum of the host_earnings account deltas

reserve_balance.meaning: earnings held back against open exposure; identically the sum of the payout_reserve account deltas

next_payout_date.meaning: the next date on which this account is due to be swept

tax_form_status.meaning: state of the tax documentation the account needs before money can leave it

statement_delivery.meaning: how the host receives their earnings statement

hold_reason.meaning: why the account is on hold; none while it settles normally

ledger_id.meaning: primary id of the payout ledger entry

payout_account_id.meaning: the payout account the entry is booked to (foreign key -> payouts_accounts)

customer_id.meaning: the host the entry belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

booking_id.meaning: the trip the entry arises from (foreign key -> trips_bookings); empty on entries that arise from no single trip

source_ledger_id.meaning: the earlier ledger entry this one reverses, releases or corrects; empty on an original entry

event_type.meaning: event-family type of this entry, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the payouts charter

entry_amount.meaning: money moved by this entry; credits to the host are positive and debits are negative

entry_basis.meaning: the item this entry stands for; the dimension that keeps two entries booked on the same day apart

payout_method.meaning: how the money left the account on a transfer entry; none on entries that move no money out

hold_reason.meaning: why money was withheld on this entry; none on entries that hold nothing

statement_period.meaning: the earnings statement month this entry is reported in

settlement_reference.meaning: the bank or partner reference the host quotes for this movement, stored exactly as given; empty when there is none

payout_request_id.meaning: primary id of a host's request to be paid out

customer_id.meaning: the host asking to be paid (foreign key -> customers)

payout_account_id.meaning: the payout account the request is made against (foreign key -> payouts_accounts)

requested_amount.meaning: amount the host asked to draw

payout_method.meaning: how the host asked to be paid

request_status.meaning: how far the payout request has got

requested_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

vehicle_id.meaning: primary id of the vehicle listing record

customer_id.meaning: the host who owns the listing (foreign key -> customers)

value_class_name.meaning: the value class the listing sits in, written as the official full class name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the listing (basis defined in the listings lifecycle)

listed_date.meaning: date the vehicle first went live on the marketplace; empty while still in draft

delisted_date.meaning: date the vehicle was taken off the marketplace for good; empty while it is still listable

make.meaning: vehicle make exactly as it appears on the registration document

model.meaning: vehicle model exactly as it appears on the registration document

model_year.meaning: model year of the vehicle, the basis of every vehicle-age condition

vin_last6.meaning: the last six characters of the vehicle identification number, used to tell two otherwise identical listings apart

odometer_miles.meaning: the odometer reading most recently recorded for the vehicle

market_value_amount.meaning: the marketplace's current valuation of the vehicle, which decides the value class

daily_price_amount.meaning: the daily price the host currently asks for the vehicle

title_status.meaning: how the vehicle is owned and titled, which decides whether it may be listed at all

lienholder_name.meaning: name of the finance company or lessor recorded on the title, stored exactly as given; empty when the vehicle is owned outright

home_city.meaning: city the vehicle is based in and returned to

seat_count.meaning: how many seat belts the vehicle has

fuel_type.meaning: what the vehicle is fuelled by

inspection_due_date.meaning: date by which the next marketplace inspection must be completed

miles_to_next_inspection.format: whole miles, may be negative once the interval is overrun
miles_to_next_inspection.meaning: miles left before the next inspection falls due; identically the sum of the inspection_mileage_credit account deltas

last_inspection_date.meaning: date of the most recent completed inspection; empty when the vehicle has never been inspected

registration_state.meaning: two-letter code of the state the vehicle is registered in

registration_expiry_date.meaning: date the vehicle registration expires; the listing may not stay live past it

suspension_reason.meaning: why the listing is suspended; none while it is in good standing

inspection_id.meaning: primary id of the vehicle condition record

vehicle_id.meaning: the listing the record belongs to (foreign key -> listings_vehicles)

customer_id.meaning: the host who owns the listing (foreign key -> customers)

booking_id.meaning: the trip whose return produced this reading; empty on records taken outside a trip

source_inspection_id.meaning: the earlier condition record this one re-examines or corrects; empty on a first record

event_type.meaning: event-family type of this record, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the listings charter

odometer_reading.meaning: odometer shown at this record; 0 on records that carry no reading

miles_delta.meaning: change booked to the vehicle's inspection mileage credit; positive when a completed inspection grants a fresh interval and negative when driven miles consume it

inspection_outcome.meaning: what the inspection found; not_applicable on records that are not inspections

inspection_channel.meaning: how the record was produced, which decides how authoritative it is

defect_code.meaning: the fault this record registers; none when nothing was found

value_class_assessed.meaning: the value class this record concluded the vehicle belongs in; unassessed on records that do not value the vehicle

assessed_value_amount.meaning: the vehicle value this record established; 0.00 on records that do not value the vehicle

document_kind.meaning: the document this record verifies; none on records that verify no document

photo_count.meaning: how many photographs are attached to this record

next_due_miles.meaning: the inspection interval granted by this record; 0 on records that grant no interval

review_id.meaning: primary id of a listing review case

customer_id.meaning: the host whose listing is under review (foreign key -> customers)

vehicle_id.meaning: the listing under review (foreign key -> listings_vehicles)

review_reason.meaning: why the listing was put in front of a reviewer

review_status.meaning: how far the review has got

submitted_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
submitted_at.meaning: moment the case was put into the review queue

supporting_document_count.meaning: how many supporting documents the host attached to the case

subscription_id.meaning: primary id of the roadside assistance subscription

customer_id.meaning: the member who holds the subscription (foreign key -> customers)

vehicle_id.meaning: the vehicle the subscription covers (foreign key -> listings_vehicles)

roadside_plan_name.meaning: the roadside plan in force, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the subscription (basis defined in the roadside lifecycle)

started_date.meaning: date cover began; empty until the subscription is activated

ended_date.meaning: date cover ceased; empty while cover is still running

renewal_date.meaning: date the subscription term next renews

callout_credits_remaining.format: whole credits, may be negative once the allowance is overdrawn
callout_credits_remaining.meaning: callouts still included in the term; identically the sum of the callout_credits account deltas

service_region.meaning: the territory the plan dispatches within

enrolled_channel.meaning: how the member came to hold this subscription

callout_id.meaning: primary id of the roadside callout record

subscription_id.meaning: the subscription the callout is made under (foreign key -> roadside_subscriptions)

customer_id.meaning: the member who called for assistance (foreign key -> customers)

booking_id.meaning: the trip the callout happened on; empty when the vehicle was not on a trip

source_callout_id.meaning: the earlier callout this record re-attends or corrects; empty on a first record

event_type.meaning: event-family type of this record, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the roadside charter

service_code.meaning: the assistance actually provided; none on records that provide no service

credits_delta.meaning: change booked to the subscription's callout allowance; positive when credits are granted and negative when a callout consumes one

tow_miles.meaning: distance the vehicle was towed; 0 when it was not towed

callout_fee_amount.meaning: amount charged to the member for this callout; 0.00 when it fell inside the allowance

responder_reference.meaning: the recovery operator's job reference, stored exactly as the member reads it out; empty when none was given

care_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the vehicle care plan

customer_id.meaning: the host who holds the care plan (foreign key -> customers)

vehicle_id.meaning: the vehicle the care plan services (foreign key -> listings_vehicles)

care_plan_name.meaning: the care plan in force, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the care plan (basis defined in the service lifecycle)

started_date.meaning: date the care plan began; empty until it is activated

ended_date.meaning: date the care plan ceased; empty while it is still running

next_service_due_date.meaning: date the next included service falls due

service_credits_remaining.format: whole credits, may be negative once the allowance is overdrawn
service_credits_remaining.meaning: included services still unused in the term; identically the sum of the service_credits account deltas

billing_day.meaning: day of the month the plan subscription is billed on

preferred_shop_reference.meaning: the partner workshop the host asks to be sent to, stored exactly as given; empty when the host has no preference

visit_id.meaning: primary id of the workshop visit record

care_plan_id.meaning: the care plan the visit is booked under (foreign key -> service_plans)

customer_id.meaning: the host whose vehicle was serviced (foreign key -> customers)

vehicle_id.meaning: the vehicle that was serviced (foreign key -> listings_vehicles)

source_visit_id.meaning: the earlier visit this record reworks or corrects; empty on a first record

event_type.meaning: event-family type of this record, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the service charter

visit_date.meaning: date of the workshop visit or of the billing run

service_code.meaning: the work carried out; none on records that carry no work

credits_delta.meaning: change booked to the plan's service allowance; positive when credits are granted and negative when a visit consumes one

invoice_amount.meaning: amount invoiced to the host for this record; 0.00 when the work fell inside the allowance

shop_channel.meaning: where the work was carried out, which decides how it is priced

odometer_reading.meaning: odometer recorded at the visit; 0 on records taken away from the vehicle

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record

customer_id.meaning: the member whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether the check passed; once true it never returns to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent identity check

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

customer_id.meaning: the member handed over to a human representative (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: why the conversation was handed over; a closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
